records.text: ending the suggestions, because we love them. Comments from today's episode: Ali (commenter; surname unverified) writes, 'Even if Pickles (nickname in quoted comment; identity unverified) did prove that Erika (Erika Kirk) was—wasn't at Fort Huachuca, how is that some kind of own? Because you've said from the start that you weren't sure if she was there.' I said so many times, it was ad nauseam. I was like, 'This is not something I can confirm.' You go on to write, 'You have been asking them for a statement or an alibi for months. You only got interested when they started giving fake alibis and overreacting.' It was truly you—
